# Memo 4 — Citation lists, ranges, and edited quotations

**Re:** Forms that must parse and quotations that have been edited

The relevant provisions are §§ 162 and 263, together with §§ 162(a), 263(a),
and 263A. Compare sections 1001 and 1012, and §§ 1031–1033.

Subsections § 162(a)–(c) all matter here. So do § 61(a) and (b).

An edited quotation, with an ellipsis: section 162(a) allows a deduction for
"all the ordinary and necessary expenses ... in carrying on any trade or
business."

A bracketed alteration: "[t]here shall be allowed as a deduction all the
ordinary and necessary expenses paid or incurred during the taxable year,"
I.R.C. § 162(a) (emphasis added).

A quotation that is really a fragment of the source: under § 7701(a)(30)(A),
a "citizen or resident of the United States" is a United States person.
